note: Screenshots of the real pages, served from this repository at the commit that built this book. A figure that could not be captured is recorded below with the reason, rather than shipped as a blank.

figures.name: universe-reader
figures.caption: The anchored reader. The document's extraction on the left, the frozen source and its local graph on the right, with anchor highlights driven by the byte offsets a build gate verifies rather than by re-searching the text.

figures.name: universe-graph
figures.caption: The same document's graph on its own page, with the pinned summits framing the canvas and the free nodes settled between them.

figures.name: universe-files
figures.caption: The document's folder, raw and viewed: the authored artefacts and the generated core data, every file readable as exact bytes or as a data-driven view.

figures.name: wclm
figures.caption: The deterministic transformer. The layers as columns, attention drawn as weighted arcs between them, and the winning meaning lit with the arithmetic that produced it.

figures.name: wclm-operator
figures.caption: One engine as a first-class folder: its book page, its generated schema, its provenance-marked data, its replayed example vectors and its workbench.

figures.name: methods
figures.caption: The methods register. Every technique used in earnest before being written down, each naming the release where it first shipped.

figures.name: lexicon
figures.caption: The scoped lexicon. Each term with what it is near but is not, and every override recorded with its authority and the superseded definition kept visible.

figures.name: capability-scale
figures.caption: The capability scale. Five vaults' permission blocks lined up into a floor, a hard middle and a ceiling, which is this book's thesis in a security register.
